name: Schedules
overview: Scripture teaches that our time on earth is limited and should be wisely managed, as Psalms 90:12 urges us to number our days to gain wisdom. While we may plan our paths with diligence and care, Proverbs 16:9 reminds us that the Lord ultimately directs our steps, emphasizing the need for dependence on Him. The Bible encourages thoughtful planning and patience, contrasting the fruitfulness of diligence with the poverty that comes from haste (Proverbs 21:5), and acknowledges that there is an appointed time for every purpose under heaven (Ecclesiastes 3:1). Therefore, believers are called to walk wisely and circumspectly, making the most of their time according to God's sovereign timing (Ephesians 5:15).
